items.title: Howard Levy interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 11, 2025
items.q: the first gig I played with Tito Puente

ctx.x: As you proceeded through the task of writing, did you find that you arrived at a place with adjectives and describing words that helped get the message across about the music you were doing? Because writing about music can be challenging and frustrating as well.

Yeah. You know it’s – the stories, it’s a far ranging range of stories. I mean music is in all of them, but some of them are more personal experiences with music as part of it. But of course I did you know, write out some changes, you know G seven sharp nine flat thirteenth and stuff like that. I wrote those kind of things out. I mean there was some very specifically musical things and I tried not to geek out too much on some of those things. But yeah it is hard. But I think what really made it work (I hope it…
Yeah, we call them club dates and casuals.
